title: Mood score
text: Score the day from 0 to 100 promptly, before sleep, using the same personal scale each time. There is no published limit; the value only moves the personal baseline.
A low run of scores, or any thought of harming yourself or others, goes to the crew medical officer and trusted crewmates at once.
design_note: Baseline scoring only: no published single-reading limit.
